text:
emily: kicking off staged rollout for inference v2.6 -> 15% traffic in us-west1 + eu-west1. change-window 22:00 UTC. tagging ops for stop/go.

deploy-bot: rollout started: v2.6 -> 15% in us-west1, eu-west1. canary_id=cb-1908765432.

marco: seeing p99 embed latency jump in eu-west1 around 21:12 UTC, p50 normal. embedding endpoint errors 0.2% (mostly 504). grafana -> https://grafana/redwood/d/.../cb-1908765432

emily: thanks marco. is this consistent across hosts or localized?

nick: looks localized to a subset of hosts behind nodepool-b, CPU saturation + EVS network retries. might be transient after a config tweak in the allocator.

sam: vote -> hold eu-west and keep us-west running at 15%. want to pin eu-west routing to v2.5 until we triage.

ops: applying routing override: eu-west1 -> pinned v2.5 now.

deploy-bot: action recorded: route-override/1908765432/eu -> eu-west1 pinned to v2.5. status: REGION_HOLD.

emily: please capture heap/cpu traces and a request sample set before we lose the window.

ops: pulling traces and request logs to /incidents/cb-1908765432. heap/strace collected.

peggy: updating release tracker and customer-impact board: "regional hold eu-west due to embed tail latency". noting no broad rollback.

nick: quick mitigation: scaling nodepool-b by +2 and disabling the allocator tweak for that pool. will monitor.

marco: re-running synthetic embed load now, will post updated p99 in 10m.

emily: setting resume-check +45m. if p99 improves and errors <0.1% we resume eu-west to 20% then proceed.

sam: flagging that v2.6 release notes mention memory footprint changes for embedding cache 1; add to postmortem checklist.

deploy-bot: scheduled: resume-check at 1908768132. watchers: emily, ops, nick.

emily: thanks team. keep updates in-thread and post final decision here.
